body: While ReleaseManager provides backup snapshot and restore mechanics, failed post-deployment smoke tests currently block the release gate without automatically executing rollback, leaving target environments in an inconsistent or degraded state. This item implements automatic rollback orchestration on failed smoke tests.
_note: Full authoring of context, epic, and ACs

brief.problem: Post-deployment smoke test failures currently require manual rollback commands, creating prolonged downtime if an unhealthy platform revision is released.
brief.what_adds: Automated Deployment Rollback Orchestration: trigger instant rollback and record evidence on failed post-deploy smoke tests.

label: PF Backlog 691
risks: Flapping rollbacks from intermittent network blips mitigated via retry threshold before rollback trigger.
title: Automated Deployment Rollback Orchestration: trigger instant rollback and record evidence on failed post-deploy smoke tests
summary: Wire an automated rollback trigger into the deployment execution pipeline that immediately restores the previous stable release snapshot and records immutable rollback evidence upon smoke test failure.
approach: Extend core/release_manager.py with post-deploy verification harness that invokes provider.rollback() upon smoke test failure.
rollback: Manual operator override to force deployment retention.
objective: Implement automated fail-closed rollback orchestration that triggers instant reversion to the prior stable release upon failed post-deploy smoke tests.

api_impact.reason: Packaging, deployment, and verification CLI/core capability; no dedicated HTTP routes required

verification: Simulated failure tests asserting automated rollback invocation, prior state restoration, and evidence emission.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Post-deployment smoke test runner executes automated health, database connectivity, and core API verification immediately after deployment.
AC-2: Any failing smoke test assertion automatically triggers instant rollback to prior healthy revision within 30 seconds.
AC-3: Rollback orchestration records comprehensive failure evidence, diagnostic logs, and incident report in deployment evidence ledger.
